name: HubSpot
verdict: A HubSpot OAuth app works the same day, then stops at 25 customer installs until your Marketplace listing is approved. New apps are built as projects with HubSpot's CLI, not just in a web form.

creation.label: Moderate
creation.note: CLI project setup on the developer platform (2025.2+). Not tested by us.

handsOn.note: Developer account, CLI project, config file, upload.

waiting.note: Marketplace review timeline not stated on pages we read.

ownApp.headline: Check Composio first.
ownApp.note: Composio publishes a HubSpot custom-app guide; managed availability not confirmed.

oneWayDoors.title: The 25-install cap applies to new and migrated apps.
oneWayDoors.detail: Apps created with marketplace distribution, or legacy public apps migrated to the new platform, are capped at 25 installs until listed. Migrating an app with more installs applies the cap automatically.
oneWayDoors.doThis: Do not migrate a busy legacy app without a listing plan.

oneWayDoors.title: Required vs optional scopes shape installs.
oneWayDoors.detail: Users can untick optional scopes at install. Required scopes can make cautious admins abandon the install.
oneWayDoors.doThis: Put anything your agent can live without into optional scopes.

notes.title: Conflicting limit for private OAuth
notes.text: The Manage apps page says 10 allowlisted accounts. The changelog says 10 for app partners and 100 for Solution Partners.

scopes.intro: Scopes are set in app-hsmeta.json as required or optional and uploaded with `hs project upload`.
changingLater: Edit app-hsmeta.json and run `hs project upload`.
Existing installs must reauthorize for new required scopes (not verified).

forApproval: Signed Acceptable Use Policy (Distribution tab, "Begin publishing")

steps.title: Create a developer account
steps.detail: Apps live in projects on the developer platform.

steps.title: Scaffold the project with the CLI
steps.detail: Set auth to OAuth, distribution to marketplace, redirectUrls and scopes in app-hsmeta.json.

steps.title: Begin publishing and sign the AUP
steps.detail: Until signed, installs only work in developer test accounts.

steps.title: Copy credentials into Composio
steps.detail: Development, Projects, your app, Auth tab.
